frontmatter.name: graph-automation
frontmatter.description: Run a task as a graph of bounded nodes and leave behind a rerunnable automation. graphify maps the source material, the task is split into nodes with one input, one output and one check each, deterministic steps run as code, model steps run as bounded subagents behind evidence gates, and graph.md, checks.md and progress.md make the run resumable, repeatable and schedulable. Use this whenever the user wants work done "as a graph of nodes", mentions bounded nodes, node graphs, gates, graph.md, check
frontmatter.argument-hint: "<task>" [--output P] [--sources P ...] [--checks "text::cmd" ...] [--scope G ...] [--limit N] [--slug s] [--auto] [--no-map] | resume <slug> | rerun <slug> [--sources P ...] | status <slug>
